# HIVE

> HIVE CLI helps developers build a local MCP server for an existing TypeScript Next.js App Router product and review which capabilities agents can use.

## When to use HIVE

Use HIVE when you maintain a TypeScript Next.js App Router application and want to scan its existing API capabilities, review generated MCP tools, and run a local MCP server. Re-scan after your application changes. The current beta generates a local, single-user server; it does not provide a hosted MCP endpoint or production OAuth.

## Start here

- Documentation: https://www.usehive.tech/docs
- Configuration: https://www.usehive.tech/docs/configuration
- CLI commands: https://www.usehive.tech/docs/commands
- Official npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@usehive/cli
- Website sitemap: https://www.usehive.tech/sitemap.xml

Run from the root of a supported app with Node.js 22.12 or newer:

```sh
npx @usehive/cli scan --install
```

Review discovered capabilities before approving write or destructive tools. Follow the documentation to configure the generated server and connect a local MCP client.
